tei:div.tei:p: (71)srod kyi dus 'di la gzhol nus na/ hūm̐ ya manta ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āḥ rang snang skad cig dran rdzogs su/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ 'jigs byed tshe bdag mthing nag rngam: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis ni/ pad nyi bam gyi gdan la 'gying*/ g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon lcags 'khor/ spyan gsum dmar zlum mche ba gcigasaḥ dmar ser ral bsigs las gshin 'gyed/ ha ha'i gad rgyang stong gsum 'dar: dpal chen 'bar ba'i chas gos gsolaḥ 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i he ru ka gnyis med rang 'od yum dang 'khril/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis/ khro chung las gshin skar ltar 'khrig lta log sa bdag klu gnyen dang*/ rgyal bsen dam sri 'dar med brlag rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid nas/ thugs rje rol pas gnas 'dir gshegs/ ro mnyam dgyes bzhugs bde stong (72)gi mchod sprin 'bar ba'i lha la stobs/ stobs bcu rdzogs pa bcom ldan 'das/ dbang bcu'i mthar son khro bo'i rgyal/ ma 'dres lhun rdzogs 'bar ba yi/ khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ hūm̐/ rang nyid khro bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du oṃ ya manta ka hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bskor bas 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod nas nus mthu byin rlabs thams cad khro rgyal gshin rje gshed kyis sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnam par sku dgyes pas gar dang*/ gsung ha ha'i sgra dang*/ thugs bde chen 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas byon nas bdag la sib sib thim par bsam mo/ slar yang 'od 'phros sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs zhing khyad par gnod byed kyi bsam ngan zhi nas phan pa'i sems dang ldan par bsgom la sngags bzla'o/ drag po'i las kyis gnod byed tshar bcad pa la/ rang nyid lha'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang (73)gzhan yang sku'i phyogs thams cad nas 'gugs byed las gshin dkar po lcags kyu thogs pa dang*/

chings byed las gshin ser po zhags pa thogs pa dang*/ sdom byed las gshin dmar po lcags sgrog thogs pa dang*/ myos byed las gshin ljang nag dril bu thogs pa grangs med pa phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad du 'phros nas gnod byed thams cad kyi snying ka'i sgo phyes nas de dag gi srog snying thams cad lcags kyus gzungs zhags pas chings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdam/ dril bus myos par byas nas dregs pa'i gtso bo kun 'dar zhing brgyal/ dbang med du bsdus par bsam la/ oṃ ya ma rā ja/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya kṣe ya/ ya kṣe yatstsha/ ni rā ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ bar ma chad pa lu gu rgyud 'bar ba'i me 'ur 'ur 'bar zhing gseb nas khro chung grangs med 'phro ba drag po'i hūm̐ glu (74)len pas/ phyi snod bcud/ nang lus sems/ gsang ba gang la bden zhen gyi rnam pa thams cad/ phar thal tshur thal du phug pas nad gdon bar chad thams cad mes bsregs hūm̐ gis gtor/ khro chung gis zhal du stobs par

bsam la/ rtsa sngags dang hūm̐ glu brtsegs ma drag la ngar thung ba bzla'o/ de nas chos nyid bsam brjod bral ba la blo bzhag go 'di 'dra'i bsnyon tshig zang ma 'di/ kho bo las kyi rdo rje yis/ rtogs med ha po'i nam mkha' la/ ma rig gdon gyis sprin gseb nas/ dran pa'i glog 'gyu de ltar lags/// /
